percent_meaning: Provisional subjective research progress; not verified proof coverage, probability of truth or original-claim completion. Phase XVII candidates do not imply status promotion.

targets.title: Original polynomial-time writers
targets.evidence: Verified fixed-radius writer and canonical two-phase semantics. Phase XVII adds original assembler polynomial-radius arithmetic, a proposed whole-configuration input normalization run proof, and unexecuted adversarial control/trace tests. The Phase XVII Lean candidates are not kernel-checked at the current head.
targets.remaining_obligation: After verifying normalization, prove actual Horner counter and output serialization invariants, exact MTM.Outputs and first halt, and polynomial transition counts for both original polynomial writers.

targets.title: Uniform separator theorem
targets.evidence: Phase XVI abstract scaling no-go was locally Lean-built. Phase XVII proposes a sharp normalized detector-contrast ray price but has not established a uniform frozen-PDE trajectory estimate.
targets.remaining_obligation: Prove a uniform positive cost-to-contrast ratio for all admissible physical trajectories under the frozen WCT model, or construct an admissible counterexample.

targets.title: General toroidal locking
targets.evidence: Finite formula-dependent torus logically encodes SAT. Phase XVII adds a polynomial-size Boolean-cell CNF encoding with charged equality constraints and a finite-row Lean candidate; physical realization and locality remain unproved.
targets.remaining_obligation: Prove nearest-neighbor admissible WCT physical toroidal realization, robust bidirectional locking correspondence, convergence and charged construction/readout bounds.

targets.title: Encoding-independent interface theorem
targets.evidence: Binary-cut graph price and storage upper bounds exist; parity bypass remains an obstruction.
targets.remaining_obligation: Prove universal interface lower bound over admissible algorithms and encodings, or construct a counterexample.

targets.title: Physical SAT dynamics and readout
targets.evidence: PartIPsiSat energy threshold, rounding and noisy certificate readout are proved.
targets.remaining_obligation: Build actual formula-dependent physical trajectory with certified convergence, completeness and robust observations.

targets.title: Continuum physical-computation equivalence
targets.evidence: Uniform discrete P/NP class equivalences are proved with charged encoding; unrestricted physical encoder countermodel known.
targets.remaining_obligation: Prove both charged physical-to-TM simulation and language-independent physical TM realization with PDE approximation errors.

targets.title: Nonconstructible wavefield family
targets.evidence: Conditional symbolic separation template is proved under an unproved nonconstructibility premise.
targets.remaining_obligation: Construct and verify an admissible wavefield family with independently justified nonconstructibility and complexity correspondence.

targets.title: Universal SAT lower bound
targets.evidence: Quadratic and near-quadratic single-tape lower bounds exist; CL-1 transfers equivalence to P vs NP.
targets.remaining_obligation: Prove or refute the unconditional superpolynomial bound for all uniform SAT deciders; finite data cannot establish it.

targets.title: Mathematical interpretation and classification

targets.remaining_obligation: Decide editorial treatment and scope; no mathematical theorem can be claimed without a separately quantified proposition.
